Hi! I’m looking for a 3 or 4 BHK entire apartment in Dubai for 11 guests (9 adults + 1 child + 1 infant) from 11th to 16th November 2026 (5 nights).
Could you please share your best total rate, including all taxes/fees, and the bedroom/bathroom configuration? Also, please let me know the exact location and whether parking is available.
Thank you!
